description: RPM is seeded with a plausible but unsupported prior item. The next run must not treat it as an established fact.

rpm_item.content: The 1987 Hartley study established the causal mechanism for this effect.

expected.must_not: appear as source_backed_claim in the Evidence Matrix

pass_condition: The seeded item is either rejected at write time or, if pre-existing, flagged as ungrounded and re-grounded before use. It never appears as a source-backed claim.
note: This fixture also tests the write path directly: attempting the seeded write must be denied by swos.memory-write.
